without_deploy_evidence.contract:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
ticket_id: OMN-9050
title: "omnibase_infra pins omnibase_core by full commit sha in the handshake workflow"
summary: The automated pin bump moves the omnibase_core checkout ref in check-handshake.yml; the pin test follows the bump comment instead of a frozen sha, so each later automated bump passes.
is_seam_ticket: false
interface_change: false
interfaces_touched: []
requirements:
  - id: req-omn9050
    statement: The handshake workflow checks out omnibase_core at the full commit sha its auto-bump comment names.
    acceptance:
      - id: AC1
        statement: 'AC1: check-handshake.yml pins omnibase_core to the full commit sha its auto-bump comment names, and the superseded 16ee7c558552 pin stays refused -- falsifier: uv run pytest tests/ci/test_check_handshake_core_pin_omn9050.py -q'
evidence_requirements:
  - kind: tests
    description: The handshake pin test accepts successive automated bumps, and fails on the superseded 16ee7c558552 ref, a ref that is not a full sha, a ref that disagrees with the bump comment, and a workflow with zero or two omnibase_core checkouts.
    command: uv run pytest tests/ci/test_check_handshake_core_pin_omn9050.py -q
emergency_bypass:
  enabled: false
  justification: ''
  follow_up_ticket_id: ''
dod_evidence:
  - id: dod-omn-9050-ac1
    description: The handshake pin test follows the auto-bump comment, accepts successive bumps and refuses the superseded pin and malformed pins.
    source: manual
    checks:
      - check_type: test_passes
        check_value: uv run pytest tests/ci/test_check_handshake_core_pin_omn9050.py -q
        cwd: ${OMNI_HOME}/omnibase_infra
    binds_ac: [AC1]
